output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS discontinued_net_revenue_eur
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p
  ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND p.is_active = false;
output.explanation: Revenue is counted only for lines of completed orders (fct_orders.is_revenue = true). Lines are joined to dim_products and filtered to discontinued products (is_active = false). The net_amount of those lines is summed over 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, the full period in the warehouse, and rounded to 2 decimals.
